title: Finance Manager
description:
Job Title: Manager – Finance, Payroll & Statutory Compliance

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 10+ Years

Focus: Internal Company Accounts, Compliance & Full-Cycle Payroll

Role Overview

Euclid Innovations is seeking a versatile Finance & Operations Manager to independently lead our internal accounting and payroll functions. This is a critical "hands-on" leadership role that covers everything from daily bookkeeping to high-level statutory compliance. You will be responsible for ensuring that our financial operations—including GST/TDS filings, payroll processing, and vendor invoicing—run like clockwork. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of the IT services/staffing landscape and is an expert in navigating Indian statutory requirements (PF, PT, ESIC).

Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Cycle Accounting: Manage overall company accounts, including bookkeeping, ledger maintenance, and financial reporting.
  • Taxation & Filings: Independently handle monthly and annual GST filings and quarterly TDS filings with 100% accuracy.
  • Payroll Management: Own the end-to-end payroll process, ensuring timely salary disbursements and accurate tax computations for all employees.
  • Statutory Compliance: Manage all aspects of PF, PT, and ESIC; stay updated on labor laws to ensure the company remains fully compliant.
  • Vendor & Client Invoicing: Oversee the invoicing lifecycle, managing payables and receivables while maintaining strong vendor relationships.
  • Audit Coordination: Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors, preparing all necessary documentation for smooth annual audits.
  • Platform Management: Utilize payroll and accounting tools (e.g., greytHR, Keka, Zoho Books) to automate and optimize financial workflows.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years in a Finance/Accounts Manager role, preferably within the IT Services or Staffing industry.
  • Core Expertise: Demonstrated experience in handling complete company accounts independently.
  • Compliance Authority: In-depth knowledge of GST, TDS, PF, ESIC, and Professional Tax (PT) regulations.
  • Invoicing Logic: Proven ability to manage complex invoicing cycles (staffing/consulting models).
  • Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with modern payroll tools (e.g., greytHR, Keka, Razorpay Payroll) and accounting software like Zoho Books or Tally.
  • Attributes: High attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work independently without constant supervision
